stones.canonical_image: When a man rides a long time through wild regions he feels the desire for a city.
stones.interactive_embodiment: Threshold ride across wind-scoured nocturnal/ochre wild ridges toward a distant nacreous spiral glimmer; striding forward (pointer drag/click, wheel, or Space/ArrowUp) intensifies longing until crossing into the dreamed city.

stones.canonical_image: Buildings with spiral staircases encrusted with spiral seashells.
stones.interactive_embodiment: Logarithmic golden-spiral architectural stairwell (r = a * exp(b * theta)) whose steps, balustrades, and vaults are encrusted with procedural calcified spiral shells (nautilus, turritella, murex); rotating/stepping along the spiral navigates the chambers of desire and advances time.

stones.canonical_image: Where perfect telescopes and violins are made.
stones.interactive_embodiment: Dual precision craft benches: (1) Luthier pegbox & spruce soundboard with 4 strings tuned in perfect 3:2 fifths (G3 196.00Hz, D4 293.66Hz, A4 440.00Hz, E5 659.25Hz) via interactive pegs and pluck/bow WebAudio synthesis; (2) Brass astronomical refractor optical bench with vernier drawtube focus wheel collapsing chromatic aberration halos into razor-sharp constellations and distant shell-domes.

stones.canonical_image: Where the foreigner hesitating between two women always encounters a third.
stones.interactive_embodiment: Twin arched loggias framing two luminous silhouettes; leaning pointer, focus, or selection toward either Woman I or Woman II parts the shadow and archway light of a central/oblique alcove so a Third Woman steps unmistakably into view—perpetually subverting binary possession.

stones.canonical_image: Where cockfights degenerate into bloody brawls among the bettors.
stones.interactive_embodiment: Chalked pit with two circling iridescent gamecocks surrounded by a ring of tense bettors; approaching or pressing the stake triggers an explosive flurry of crimson feathers that spills outward as the bettors themselves collide in a chaotic bloody brawl with low percussive WebAudio thuds.

stones.canonical_image: In the square there is the wall where the old men sit and watch the young go by; he is seated in a row with them. Desires are already memories.
stones.interactive_embodiment: Weathered limestone parapet rising across the lower square where a row of cloaked old men sit shoulder-to-shoulder with one open seat awaiting the traveler; brisk silhouettes of the young walk past in the square while accumulated desires seat the visitor irreversibly in the row of elders.

calvino_source.inner_arch: Isidora contains every exact thing the traveler dreamed of—with one difference: the dreamed city contained him as a young man, whereas he arrives in old age and is seated in a row along the square's stone wall watching youth pass by ('Desires are already memories').

anti_trude_vector.medium: Logarithmic nautilus-spiral spatial instrument, plucked WebAudio violin-fifth luthier bench, and vernier brass telescope optical bench receding irreversibly onto the limestone parapet of the old men's wall, paired with Royal Plate Guild copperplate cartography (map.png + map.svg) and fine-art architectural plate (image.png).
anti_trude_vector.causal_inversion_law: Pursuing ANY desire at the spiral's center (rotating the seashell staircase, tuning/plucking violin fifths, focusing the brass telescope, hesitating between two women to encounter a third, escalating the cockfight into a bettors' brawl) strictly and irreversibly increments ageProgress in [0, 1] with zero rewind button. As ageProgress accumulates, the spiral viewport recedes across the piazza, warm youth nacre shifts into sepia-limestone dusk, WebAudio harmonics pass through an aging piazza distance filter, the stone wall rises in the foreground, and at ageProgress >= 0.90 the traveler's agency settles into the empty stone seat among the row of old men—where engaging any desire dispatches a passing youth in the square to live it at a distance while the parapet inscribes it as memory.
anti_trude_vector.morphological_signature: Bespoke HTML5 Autonomous Custom Elements (<isidora-chronicle>, <wild-region-approach>, <nautilus-stairwell>, <seashell-whorl>, <luthier-pegbox>, <brass-refractor>, <hesitation-loggia>, <cockfight-pit>, <elders-parapet-wall>, <elder-row-seat>, <passing-youth-frieze>, <memory-inscription-ledge>, <isidora-plate-vault>, <nautilus-atlas-folio>) and .isidora-* CSS selectors guaranteeing Jaccard DOM/CSS similarity J_dom < 0.35 against all Atlas cities.

interface_contract.script_format: Plain browser JS IIFEs (NO ES module import/export syntax) attaching window.IsidoraSpiralDesires and window.IsidoraOldMensWall so weaver can inline both scripts directly into standalone index.html.

IsidoraSpiralDesires.onDesirePursued_payload: { station: 'spiral'|'violin'|'telescope'|'hesitation'|'cockfight', deltaAge: number, label: string, memoryEcho: string, intensity: number }

methods.mount: (canvasEl, controlsRootEl) => void — attaches pointer/keyboard listeners and builds bespoke accessible station controls inside controlsRootEl using custom tags (<luthier-pegbox>, <brass-refractor>, <hesitation-loggia>, <cockfight-pit>, <seashell-whorl>)
methods.setAgeState: ({ ageProgress, phase, isSeatedOnWall, memoryFilterHz, distanceScale }) => void — recedes spiral projection, shifts nacre-gold palette toward sepia limestone memory, and lowers WebAudio low-pass cutoff + adds piazza echo as ageProgress approaches 1
methods.actOnStation: (stationId, actionPayload) => object — executes deterministic interaction (turn spiral, pluck/tune G3-D4-A4-E5 string, adjust vernier focus, choose woman 0 or 1 revealing 3rd, incite cockfight into bettors brawl) and triggers onDesirePursued
methods.getTelemetry: () => ({ activeStation, spiralTurns, seashellCount, violinFifthsHarmony, telescopeSharpness, hesitationAttempts, thirdWomanReveals, cockfightBrawlIntensity, stationCounts, totalDesiresPursued })

methods.mount: ({ wildCanvasEl, wallCanvasEl, parapetRootEl }) => void — renders wild-region approach on wildCanvasEl, limestone wall + row of >=7 seated old men + traveler seat + passing youths on wallCanvasEl, and carved memory inscriptions inside parapetRootEl
methods.advanceWildRide: (step = 0.25) => state — advances wildRideProgress in [0, 1]; transitions phase from 'wild_ride' to 'youth_dream' at 1.0
methods.completeWildRide: () => state — completes the long ride through wild regions and enters Isidora ('youth_dream')
methods.recordDesire: ({ station, deltaAge, label, memoryEcho, intensity }) => state — STRICTLY MONOTONIC ratchet (ageProgress never decreases; calibrated ~0.09-0.12 per desire so ~9-11 pursuits reach 1.00); updates phase ('youth_dream' 0..0.39, 'twilight_drift' 0.40..0.89, 'seated_elder' 0.90..1.00), dispatches a passing youth silhouette toward the distant spiral when ageProgress >= 0.50, and appends carved memory inscription
methods.getState: () => ({ phase, wildRideProgress, ageProgress, isSeatedOnWall, eldersInRow, travelerSeated, passingYouthsActive, memoriesCarved, viewportTransform: { distanceScale, recessionY, sepia, parapetHeightRatio, memoryFilterHz } })
